messages:
ash: Heads-up — seeing a consistent p99 latency regression after the kernel-selection tweak merged yesterday. Paged-attn path, seq=1024, batch=1, kv_cached=true. Around +8–12% p99 on canary :eyes:

yana: Which commit/PR? can you paste the sha?

ash: sha abc1234 (runtime/heuristics: prefer flashattn-v2 for QKV when kv_cached). Merged ~10:30 UTC yesterday. infra-bot reported canary deploy at 2026-03-16T02:15Z.

infra-bot: deploy: canary -> eng-runtime cluster 3. commit=abc1234, user=runtime-bot, status=SUCCESS, id=deploy-20260316-0215

kyle: I started a local bisect. Narrowed it to the kernel selector change that flips to flashattn-v2 for many shapes when kv cache is hot. Quick numbers below (seq=1024, batch=1):

```
baseline (pre-change): p50=8.9ms p95=15.2ms p99=24.6ms
post-change (auto):       p50=9.1ms p95=16.1ms p99=27.0ms
force=fused:              p50=8.8ms p95=15.3ms p99=24.8ms
```

kyle: looks like fused attention wins p99 for paged-attn with these kv-cache hit patterns. flashattn-v2 improves throughput for other shapes though.

devon: Can you share a profiler flame or nvprof timeline? i'm curious if kernel launch overhead or memory stalls are bigger.

ash: pasted a short perf sample from our tracing (isolated call w/ kv warm):

```
trace snippet (ns):
attn_kernel_flash_v2_launch     6.2ms
cuda_memcpy_async               0.9ms
kernel_compute_flash_v2         18.5ms
kv_cache_lookup                 1.1ms
other                           0.3ms
```

and when forcing fused:

```
attn_kernel_fused_launch        2.8ms
cuda_memcpy_async               1.0ms
kernel_compute_fused            20.0ms
kv_cache_lookup                 1.0ms
other                           0.2ms
```

ash: interestingly flash has bigger launch latency but slightly lower compute; for p99 launch variance seems to dominate for these small batches.

yana: That suggests the selector's scoring metric didn't account for launch jitter under paged-attn + kv hot path. The heuristic weights might be off.

kyle: I ran a quick experiment toggling the selector threshold (heuristic score cutover). Changing threshold from 0.8 -> 0.92 stops picking flashattn-v2 for seq=1024+kv_hot and restores p99. Will run matrix across seq lengths.

ash: repro command I used (run on perf worker):

```
./perf_runner --model redwood/llama-13b --seq 1024 --batch 1 --kv_cached --kernel-selection=auto --trials 500 --trace=attn
```

ash: Results with KERNEL_FORCE=fused env var on same worker:
```
export KERNEL_FORCE=fused
./perf_runner ...
# p99 ~= 24.7ms (matches baseline)
```

ash: forcing fused is a valid short-term mitigation for canary. Needs a permanent fix in selector.

devon: Can we add a micro-benchmark that measures kernel_launch_stddev across shapes + kv states? If launch variance is the issue we should reflect that in scoring. I can add a perf test.

yana: Agreed. Also add an opt-in flag to keep old heuristic during rollout. For Dedicated customers we might want conservative defaults.

kyle: I'll open a small PR to: 1) add launch-variance sample to the scoring vector, 2) bump default threshold to 0.9, 3) expose KERNEL_SELECTOR_OVERRIDE env var for canary. Running full seq x batch x kv matrix now, will paste numbers.

ash: Created issue: https://go/redwood/issue/INF-9482 (kernel-selector: account for kernel-launch variance in paged-attn + kv-hot). Linking the repro and bisect notes.

infra-bot: ticket created INF-9482 by ash, severity=medium, labels=[perf, runtime, attention]

devon: I'll add the micro-bench and a dashboard panel showing p50/p95/p99 delta when selector changes. Also include a regression alert rule.

ash: For immediate canary mitigation, i'll patch canary config to set KERNEL_FORCE=fused for paged-attn nodes. Will monitor.

yana: Thanks. Once kyle's PR lands let's run canary AB with both heuristics and the new scoring so we can quantify improvements.

kyle: quick numbers from the matrix so far (seq x batch x kv state, p99 pct-change auto vs fused):
```
seq=512 b=1 kv_hot: +2%
seq=1024 b=1 kv_hot: +10%  <-- main regression
seq=1024 b=4 kv_hot: -3%   <-- flash helps with larger batches
seq=2048 b=1 kv_cold: -5%
```

ash: Good to know flip sign by batch. We'll apply targeted selector rule (prefer fused for batch<=1 && kv_hot && seq in [512,1024]).

devon: i'm adding a unit to perf-tests/attn/kernel_launch_variance.py and a grafana panel. will send PR.

ash: status update in 30m after canary patch. thanks all :thumbsup:
